issues.where: sunlit cloud bands and blue north polar hood
issues.what: the atmosphere is soft and airbrushed, with horizontal smear instead of fine turbulence, so the globe reads as painted
issues.fix: rebuild the cloud and polar textures to the native detail of the other frame and remove the directional smear

issues.where: panel A cloud deck and panel C terminator
issues.what: at native size the cloud bands are smeared and plastic, and the eddies in the other frame's matching crops are gone
issues.fix: restore high-frequency cloud structure here and keep the terminator falloff soft without smearing the lit bands

issues.where: panel L, north polar hood and high-latitude bands
issues.what: the polar gradient is a smooth horizontally streaked wash, with stretched texture and no fine structure
issues.fix: replace the smeared hood with a stable, unsmeared vortex texture and stop the horizontal stretch

issues.where: panel B and panel D ring arcs
issues.what: the ringlets are soft, and the fine divisions in the other frame's native ring crops are lost
issues.fix: sharpen these ring arcs to the same native ringlet detail without adding stair-steps

issues.where: panel M, Titan against the starfield
issues.what: the moon is a soft featureless disk, blurrier than the pinpoint stars beside it
issues.fix: match the moon limb to the starfield and keep only a thin hazy falloff

issues.where: left narrow ring strip, panel S
issues.what: the ring bands are smeared along the diagonal, unlike the sharper ring crops on the same sheet
issues.fix: remove the directional smear so this strip matches the sharp ringlet crops beside it

issues.where: crop A, lower tip of the bright limb where it crosses the rings
issues.what: A straight, translucent wedge extends the limb down into the ring texture, leaving a visible compositing seam.
issues.fix: Rebuild the globe and ring occlusion with a shared depth pass and stop limb scattering from leaking over the foreground ring.

issues.where: crop P, lower-left limb above the foreground rings
issues.what: A rust-colored strip with an abrupt vertical end sits outside the smooth bright limb and reads as a separate patch.
issues.fix: Align the limb, ring overlap and shadow mattes so the strip follows the sphere and its shading blends into the surrounding clouds.

issues.where: crops T through W, foreground rings
issues.what: The dense parallel lines run uninterrupted along the ring arcs, with much more detail across each band than along it. At native size the rings look stretched and combed.
issues.fix: Keep the large radial divisions but vary particle density and fine clumping along the arcs, then filter the narrowest lines for the viewing angle.

issues.where: crops A and I, lit cloud belts and blue polar cap
issues.what: The cloud belts blur into broad pastel bands and the polar cap is a smooth patch with little internal structure, giving the globe an airbrushed finish.
issues.fix: Retain smaller cloud structures through the highlights and across the polar cap, and reduce the broad surface softening.

issues.where: crop V, bright bands just below the cast shadow
issues.what: Fine repeated crosshatching is visible where the narrowest ring lines bunch together.
issues.fix: Increase render sampling and use anisotropic filtering on the shallow-angle ring texture.

issues.where: crop I, moon above the polar cap
issues.what: The moon has a fuzzy golden limb and an almost featureless lit face compared with the pinpoint stars nearby.
issues.fix: Tighten the moon's edge response and add faint albedo variation without over-sharpening the small disc.
